name: Future Skills Academy
summary: Self-paced online AI training with accredited certification programs, a career counselor on the top plan and team plans with an admin dashboard.
best_for: individuals who want a self-paced AI certification, and small teams who want to train two or more people with an admin dashboard
skip_if: you want a free plan beyond one intro course, need a refund window longer than 7 days, or want independently verified accreditation before you pay
honest_knock: Dollar signs are shown without a currency code, and the headline prices sit next to crossed-out higher prices, so check the price at checkout. Premium and Standard are billed yearly even though they are quoted per month. The refund window is 7 days, with conditions on progress and downloads. The accreditation, the learner counts and the testimonials on the site are the vendor's own claims, not verified by us. A free course is listed, but there is no free membership.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Standard · Standard shown as $25 a month billed yearly (a crossed-out $50 is shown next to it) for one certification program and a year of access
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-06 on futureskillsacademy.com/pricing) Future Skills Academy sells three plans. Standard costs $25 a month billed yearly (the page shows a crossed-out $50 next to it) and covers one accredited certification program with unlimited access for one year. Premium costs $75 a month billed yearly (crossed-out $150) and covers all certification programs, the full content library, a dedicated study counselor and CV preparation, and a customized study plan. Teams costs $50 a month (crossed-out $100) with a minimum of 2 team members and adds an admin dashboard, progress reports, custom training tracks and team counselors; the page does not say whether the Teams price is per member or how it is billed. The page shows dollar signs without naming a currency. A banner on the page advertises 20% off all learning plans with a code; we did not check how long that runs. One introductory course, AI for Everyone, is listed as free; that is not a free membership. The refund policy allows a refund request only within 7 days of enrollment, and only if no more than 10% of a certification was completed and no presentations were downloaded.

compare_with.name: Evolve
compare_with.why: Evolve is in our dossiers as an AI-native training platform (an LMS) that enterprises use to build their own branded academies. Future Skills Academy instead sells ready-made AI certification courses to individuals and teams, so it is a different kind of purchase. We have not compared the two on price
